2014_spells.greater-restoration.descript:
You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect. You can reduce the target's exhaustion level by one, or end one of the following effects on the target: 
- One effect that charmed or petrified the target 
- One curse, including the target's attunement to a cursed magic item 
- Any reduction to one of the target's ability scores 
- One effect reducing the target's hit point maximum
2014_spells.greater-restoration.effectSu: Make a target charmed until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.greater-restoration.fullDesc: Using 1 action, you imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect. You can reduce the target's exhaustion level by one, or end one of the following effects on the target: One effect that charmed or petrified the target One curse, including the target's attunement to a cursed magic item Any reduction to one of the target's ability scores One effect reducing the target's hit point maximum. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
